introHtml: Bag-style wine coolers and chillers offer portability that hard-sided options cannot match. Whether you need an insulated tote for corporate picnics or a backpack cooler for trade show giveaways, these soft-sided designs keep bottles at the perfect temperature while providing easy transport. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands out at any event.
